name: Cranex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1973, Cranex Ltd manufactures and sells cranes & its parts and provides maintenance services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a manufacturer of EOT Cranes and Gantry Cranes, and provides after sales service and reconditioning services

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.72% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.9% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 228 days.
Working capital days have increased from 51.2 days to 94.3 days
